decision: registered technical pilot, with commercial authorization pending

opportunities.purpose: Enable a shop with an installed compatible platform to qualify a documented retrofit for work previously outside its nozzle envelope.
opportunities.observed_change: Prusa released the HT Hotend on 2026-10-21, enabling up to 400 C on supported configurations. Published stock configurations are rated 290 C.
opportunities.incumbent: Direct manufacturer compatibility and spec lookup. Market alternatives include human distributor quoting, Partium, another industrial machine, and qualified outsourcing.
opportunities.binding_constraint: A higher nozzle requirement on an otherwise relevant installed device. Maker compatibility, chamber limits, physical approval and supplier obligations still bind.
opportunities.counterfactual: Hold the device, use, required limits and catalog scope fixed. Open the newly dated upgrade option only in the after replay. Decline when a different configuration or chamber requirement still blocks the purpose.
opportunities.commercial_gate: An authorized distributor or installed-base shop with genuine inquiries, alternative quotes and disposition/fulfillment evidence.

opportunities.purpose: Independently trace supplier answers back to authentic document pages under version changes.

opportunities.incumbent: Direct page-exact PDF extraction and competent human citation checking. A page-range fix alone has no demonstrated delivery or economic advantage.
opportunities.binding_constraint: The work needs authorized real RFQ PDFs and an independently audited before/after provenance failure.
opportunities.counterfactual: Run equal documented cases on pinned releases, direct layout extraction, and the best existing manual checking.
opportunities.commercial_gate: No lawful pilot document set or contracted outcome was provided.
